scope: Two actual FreeBSD Inner guest kernels query and synchronize to explicit local time sources on their own Red segments. Each guest clock is moved forward by two seconds before ntpdate performs a measured correction. Linux host clocks and unrelated workloads are never adjusted.

Separate guest kernels provide independent system-clock state even though they share physical KVM infrastructure. Kernel clock source, server source/address, time samples and actual adjustment diagnostics are retained.

Laboratory time sources use the host clock and have no supplied organizational trust or authoritative time-service approval. No Gray Outer synchronization or all-future drift bound is inferred. The temporary supplemental time server namespaces are cleaned after collection.
